doc_name: Islamia College of Science and Commerce, Srinagar
text: The Islamia College of Science and Commerce, Srinagar (commonly known as Islamia College or ICSC) is a University Grants Commission Autonomous College and has been accredited with an A grade by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC). Located on a 12.17-acre (0.0493 km²) campus in Hawal, Srinagar, the college is situated in the state of Jammu and Kashmir and is affiliated with the University of Kashmir. It holds the distinction of being the first college in Jammu and Kashmir to implement the CBCS (Choice Based Credit System) starting from 2015. Established in 1961 during the Prime Ministership of Bakshi Ghulam Mohammad, the institute was founded as an Autonomous Educational Institute by the Government of Jammu and Kashmir. The NAAC accredited the college at the A level on 12 September 2017, with an institutional score of 3.27 CGPA, making it the highest-rated college in Jammu and Kashmir. It was also recognized as a College for Potential Excellence by the University Grants Commission (India) in April 2010. The college operates a Mountaineering & Trekking Club affiliated with the Jammu & Kashmir Mountaineering and Trekking Association, where students actively participate in club activities. The adventure club is led by Dr. Altaf Ur Rehman, with past leadership roles held by Aga Syed Ashtar, Jasim Ali, and Syed Kumail Madni. In 2018, the college announced the introduction of three post-graduation programs.
